description: This file is a shell script for testing git cvsimport handling of vendor branches, setting up tests and verifying the import behavior with various imported file scenarios.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository for the specified test case.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to succeed, runs the given shell commands.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to fail, runs the given shell commands.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_file
methods.description: Compares the contents of a branch file against a reference file.

methods.name: test_cvs_co
methods.description: Checks out the CVS repository at the specified branch.

methods.name: test_git_co
methods.description: Checks out the Git repository at the specified branch.
